# JT-8000 v2 — MIDI Implementation Chart & Parameter Map

*Generated by `tools/gen_params.py` from `params.yaml` — do not edit.*

Every parameter is addressable by **NRPN** (CC 99 = MSB, CC 98 = LSB,
CC 6 = Data Entry MSB, CC 38 = Data Entry LSB).  NRPN number = ParamID;
MSB is the section index, LSB the index within the section.  Data Entry
MSB alone gives a 7-bit coarse set; MSB+LSB gives 14-bit resolution.
Select/toggle parameters take **direct indices** as data.

A curated set of standard CCs mirrors key performance parameters (the
**CC** column).  Reserved CCs keep their standard MIDI meaning:
1 mod wheel, 5/65 portamento, 7 volume, 11 expression, 64 sustain,
98/99/6/38/96/97/100/101 (N)RPN machinery, 120–127 channel mode.

**Schema version 1 — 143 parameters.**

### Option sets

- **osc_wave**: `SIN`, `SAW`, `SQR`, `TRI`, `ARB`, `PLS`, `rSAW`, `S&H`, `vTRI`, `BLS`, `rBLS`, `BLSQ`, `BLP`, `SSAW`
- **pitch_offset**: `-24`, `-12`, `0`, `+12`, `+24`
- **filter_engine**: `OBXa`, `VA`
- **filter_mode**: `4-Pole`, `2-Pole`, `2P BP`, `2P Push`, `Xpander`, `Xpander M`
- **v_a_filter**: `SVF LP2`, `SVF HP2`, `SVF BP2`, `SVF NOTCH`, `SVF AP`, `Moog LP4`, `Moog LP2`, `Moog BP2`, `Diode LP4`, `Korg35 LP`, `Korg35 HP`, `TPT1 LP`, `TPT1 HP`, `MoogDV LP4`, `MoogDV LP2`, `MoogDV HP4`, `MoogDV BP`
